To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) a novel framework for collaborative multimedia recommendation, interest discovery, and friendship suggestion is presented; (2) the framework is based on the combination of recommendation algorithms, clustering, tools for video annotation and evaluation of semantic resource relatedness; and (3) the framework is evaluated on the basis of user engagement, user satisfaction and the quality of the suggested content.
the combination of semantic profiling, recommendation, interest discovery, and friendship suggestion can be used to improve user engagement and content curation.

(a) a semantic approach is necessary to improve and propagate user interests through social networks, and (b) a combination of video recommendation, interest profiling and clustering techniques is necessary to provide personalized video content to users.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of novel algorithms for video recommendation, interest and friendship discovery, and their implementation and evaluation in the framework of a social video sharing platform.

the creation of targeted multimedia content for social networks, the selection of the most interesting material for their users, and the creation and propagation of interests and inter personal connection.
the creation of a framework that enables a new way of social networking and video content creation and curation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our system allows users to discover new interests, to share and comment on video content, and to create and curate their personal profiles.
the proposed system can be used for video recommendation, interest and friendship discovery and for the creation and curation (i.e., enrichment with metadata) of multimedia content.
our system provides a framework for collaborative recommendation, interest discovery, and friendship suggestion, based on semantic profiling.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are able to provide a novel framework for collaborative recommendation and interest discovery in the social network context, based on the semantic profiling of the users.
we provide a framework for the creation and management of user profiles, for the creation of a social network of interests and for the discovery of friends of friends.
we propose a novel framework for collaborative recommendation, interest discovery, and friendship suggestion, which is based on a semantic profiling.
The main takeaway from our work is that

by combining semantic profiling and recommendation techniques we are able to provide personalized services that are able to improve and propagate the users interests and inter personal relationships through the network.
the combination of these techniques can be used to provide personalized services and to improve the quality of social networks.

by exploiting the semantic information of the multimedia content, the user generated tags, the users' social connections and the users' preferences, it becomes possible to create a personalized and targeted content for each user, to discover the user's interests and to suggest friends with similar interests.
